archify.integration: Pinned CLI runtime installed by scripts/archify.mjs; upstream notices remain in the checkout.

lieflat.integration: Visual reference for five original LieflatChart families and JSON authoring: rung-bars, unit-field, barcode, bubble-matrix, and threads. No upstream code, templates, or assets bundled.

algebrica.integration: Visual reference only. Original theme and examples; no upstream content or assets bundled.

mono-color.license: MIT for code; separate terms for images
mono-color.integration: Visual reference only. Original theme; no upstream example or reference images bundled.
mono-color.originalAsset: plugins/visual-explainer/templates/assets/repair-mouse.webp — generated for Artifacture with OpenAI image generation; original opened-mouse still life, no upstream image supplied.

pr-lens.integration: Reference for ordered data-flow motion. Original Artifacture walkthrough controller; no upstream app, posting workflow, or renderer source bundled.

hairline.integration: Complete unchanged skill and interactive runtime bundled in plugins/visual-explainer/vendor/hairline-create, including upstream examples, build/look/validation guidance, and MIT LICENSE. File hashes are recorded in vendor/hairline-create/provenance.json. Hairline illustration grammar is the default host across formats, with reusable Lieflat chart encodings. The rotating-point video remains original Artifacture geometry and animation and does not include the upstream pointer engine or figure code.

3blue1brown.integration: Requested reference for mathematical visual explanation, continuous object identity, and coupled geometric motion. No upstream code, channel assets, footage, or music bundled.

typography.author: Pierrick Calvez
typography.integration: Reference for text grouping, hierarchy, measure, spacing, and optical alignment. No article text or illustrations bundled.

chalkboarding.license: MIT for code; separate third-party font terms
chalkboarding.integration: Reference for idempotent paint(time), token/batch reveal, plots, playheads, and scalar grids. Original scene builders and finite track helpers; no upstream code, chalk skin, font, media, or example assets bundled.

diagram-design.integration: Reference grammars for sequence messages, state transitions, and nested layers. Original Artifacture builders use the shared GraphicScene renderer and existing clock; no upstream skins, templates, fonts, icons, or controller copied. Axonometric plans and exploded physical assemblies adapt the newer pinned projection, occlusion and motion grammar into original shared-scene builders; the full MIT notice is copied as DIAGRAM-DESIGN-LICENSE. No upstream fonts, icons or motion controller bundled.

shader-for-interfaces.integration: Data-contract reference for original scalar-grid SVG scenes. No shader renderer, GLSL, texture, particle system, or upstream source bundled.

prettymaps.integration: Research only for geographic layer geometry, routes, and plotter export. No code, map data, Python dependency, or imagery bundled.

emil-skills.integration: Reference for trigger origins, interruption, masks, and reduced motion. Candidate finite adapters only; no upstream recipes copied into the component library.

lemo-opuscar.license: MIT for code; separate demo media/model terms
lemo-opuscar.integration: Monotone scalar/vector sampling adapted into visual-explainer-mdx/authored-values.ts; subtitle interval and millisecond-carry ideas adapted into narration-cues.ts. Full LemoLab MIT notice copied as visual-explainer-mdx/LEMO-LICENSE and included in both source-copy closures. No upstream renderer, voice model, fonts, music or demo media bundled.

pdoom-video.license: ISC package metadata; no full license grant/notice in checked tree
pdoom-video.integration: Chapter, deterministic capture and timing reference only. No source, song or media bundled.

awesome-opus-videos.license: MIT for repository; separate linked media terms
awesome-opus-videos.integration: Reference records and collection provenance only. No prompts, footage, posters or executable components bundled.

opus-video-skills.license: MIT; derived templates also retain John Heibel MIT notice
opus-video-skills.integration: Shared cue-sheet, finite capture, karaoke and beat-analysis contract references. No source, renderer, dependencies or assets bundled.

lemo-wake.integration: Frame-capture and loop-QA contract reference for original visual-explainer-mdx/video-frames.ts. Its explicit rounding and awaited snapshots distinguish authored endpoint closure from last encoded frame similarity. No upstream CC-BY-NC source, renderer, assets or QA scripts bundled.

notdwd-video-reference.integration: Read-only workflow reference for explicit shot boundaries, frame seeking, reference comparisons and full-resolution review. No prompt or footage bundled.

deedy-video-reference.integration: Read-only workflow reference for script planning, animatics, narrated code walkthroughs, word-aligned captions and screenshot/transcription review. No media or provider-specific tooling bundled.
